answer: An operator running 77 keys thus burns for 77 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the sonnet quota and the horizon admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the bridge ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 6 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
